About the Department

The Undergraduate Cyber Security Department offers a comprehensive education in safeguarding digital landscapes. Students delve into cutting-edge topics such as network security, cryptography, and ethical hacking, gaining practical skills to combat evolving cyber threats. The curriculum bridges theoretical knowledge with hands-on experiences, preparing graduates for real-world challenges. As cyber-attacks continue to escalate globally, the department meets the industry demand for skilled professionals by cultivating expertise in risk management, incident response, and secure coding practices. Graduates contribute significantly to private enterprises and governmental organizations, playing a vital role in national security. The department's focus on ethical hacking promotes responsible knowledge use, instilling principles of integrity in cyber defense. With a commitment to staying abreast of technological advancements, the Undergraduate Cyber Security Department remains at the forefront of preparing students to secure digital infrastructures and contribute to a safer, more resilient digital future.

The Cyber Security Department at ATMECE educates students on evolving cybersecurity challenges, aligning the curriculum with industry demands. Ethical practices, collaborative learning, and a global perspective are emphasized. Graduates are prepared to secure critical infrastructure and contribute to national security. Resources and networking opportunities support career development in various cybersecurity roles. The goal is to produce skilled and ethical professionals contributing effectively to the cybersecurity landscape.

Our department is not just a learning space; it is a community where each member plays a vital role. Whether you are a student navigating the complexities of cybersecurity or a faculty member shaping minds and research, your contribution is invaluable.

I encourage you to take full advantage of the resources and opportunities provided, including industry collaborations, networking events, and career development initiatives. Together, we will ensure that our graduates not only meet but exceed the demands of the ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape.

 

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion active_section="-1" collapsible_all="true"][vc_tta_section title="Vision of the Department" tab_id="1777545336882-f76dfd4b-f10b"][vc_column_text]

To nurture competent and ethical cyber security professionals capable of contributing to secure and resilient digital ecosystems.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Mission of the Department" tab_id="1777545336891-1c7996a7-71d8"][vc_column_text]
  • M1: To impart strong foundational knowledge in cyber security through effective teaching–learning practices and a continuously evolving curriculum that addresses emerging cyber threats and technologies.
  • M2: To promote research, innovation, and industry collaboration in emerging areas of cyber security to address real-world digital security challenges.
  • M3: To instill professional ethics, teamwork, leadership qualities, and a sense of social responsibility in addressing real-world cyber challenges.
  • M4: To foster a culture of lifelong learning among students by encouraging higher studies, professional development, and active engagement with the global cyber security community.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)" tab_id="1777545336901-1d37e19f-a68f"][vc_column_text]
  • PEO1 –Excel as cyber security professionals or entrepreneurs by applying strong fundamentals of cyber security engineering.
  • PEO2 – Pursue higher studies, research, and professional certifications while engaging in lifelong learning to keep pace with evolving cyber technologies and threats.
  • PEO3 – Exhibit leadership, teamwork, professional ethics, and social responsibility while addressing cyber security challenges in multidisciplinary environments.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Program Specific Objectives (PSOs)" tab_id="1777545336908-f6dfb6f2-e91b"][vc_column_text]
  • PSO1 – Apply principles of computer science, programming, algorithms, operating systems, and computer networks to design and develop efficient and reliable computing solutions.
  • PSO2 – Identify, analyze, and mitigate cyber threats and vulnerabilities using techniques related to network security, ethical hacking, penetration testing, and digital forensics.
  • PSO3 – Apply cyber security policies, cyber laws, risk management practices, and incident response strategies to ensure the protection and resilience of digital systems.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes"][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="HOD's Message"]

The Department of AIML at ATMECE is dedicated to impart constructive and quality technical education with high standards at undergraduate level. The faculty members of the department are committed to make our students by providing the expertise and proficiency in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to tackle the issues of societies.  

Department is well equipped with all modern computing facilities to meet the academic and industrial requirements.

AIML can be used to create computer programs that mimic human conversation. AIML can also be used to create virtual assistants, which are computer programs that can perform tasks such as scheduling appointments and sending emails. Additionally, AIML can be used to create educational software, which can be used to teach people about topics such as history or science.

The objective of the program is to provide an experiential learning opportunities such as hands-on experience and project-based learning, indulge in research projects, and internships which provide a strong foundation to work across the globe.

We at ATMECE more prominence is placed on elevating the students learning experience by providing value-added courses, skill-enhancement programs, and motivate students to participate in technical symposiums, hackathons organised by premier institutes across the nation.

The students, faculty, and staff of AIML at ATMECE, we believe in teamwork, we inspire, encourage each other, we help each other, and, most importantly, we trust each other. This is the key to make our students success at AIML program at ATMECE. To bring the success and laurels to the department we focus more on constructive engagements which will enable employment opportunities to our students.

I am confident that the Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at ATMECE is stalwartly prepared to face the new societal issues and challenges in this new IT era with Indian Talent (IT). We hope and assure that we transform our students in all dimensions of their life to become better citizen of this nation for better India and better world.

- Dr. J V Gorabal
